titles.title: Groton Rhine St. Façade Repair — Worked Example (v2)

descriptions.description: v2 canonical worked example for the citizen-permitting flow. A resident of Groton, CT (fictional) proposes repairing the masonry façade of a property at 42 Rhine Street. The action covers repointing of failed mortar joints, replacement of three cracked lintels, and reattachment of a decorative cornice. Validates against the bare ODCS v3.1.0 schema. The companion shim file (contracts/shim/groton-rhine-001.datacontract-shim.json) records the governance / quality / SLA / lineage metadata that is not represented in the ODCS body. Fictional. Illustrative only. The applicant, parcel, signature, and signatures are placeholders. The activity-code comes from the hand-curated ActivityConcept catalog v1.0 (ontology/activity-concept-catalog.v1.0.json). Anchoring is not approval; this contract's lifecycle.state is `draft` and the anchorReceipt is null.
